parameters.text:
=clean this input file and return only Json object
Rowdata :  {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Follow the below rules: Clean the data and return it strictly as a JSON object with these exact keys:
    - "Student_ID": This is unique key, keep as is and if duplicate found append the value "-duplicate" .
    - "Name": capitalize properly (e.g., "john doe" -> "John Doe").
    - "Email": Convert to strictly lowercase . 
    - "Phone": If less than 10 digit mark it as missing. 
    - "Course": Allow only Python , ml as Machine learning and DS as Data science. For any other value mark it as 'others' 
    - "Fee_Paid": Allowed value True / False. If yes/ YES then TRUE, if no/NO then FALSE
    - "City": Capitalize properly (e.g., "new york" -> "New York").
    - "Enrolled_Date": Standardize to YYYY-MM-DD format 
    - "Email_Valid": Evaluate if the email looks logically valid (True/False).
